content:
Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo, Apple has rolled out a series of new resources to help developers prepare for its first foldable iPhone. Here's the full rundown.

Apple shares iPhone Duo resources with developers

Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo at its "Surprise and Shine" event held earlier today. The company's first foldable phone was announced alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

In addition to revealing the iPhone Duo to the public and sharing device-related assets on its Design Resources platform, Apple has also launched a dedicated page offering a range of resources to help developers prepare for this all-new foldable device.

These include two iPhone Duo Group Labs scheduled for September 16 and 17, as well as Q&A sessions on "Photos & Camera", SwiftUI, and UIKit, each with two slots at different times, taking place on September 23.

Additionally, Apple will host iPhone Duo Workshops around the world, featuring hands-on sessions where developers can optimize their apps and "explore adaptability across all screen sizes." These workshops will begin rolling out later this month.

The "Get ready for iPhone Duo" page also lists upcoming tools and documentation, including Xcode 27.1 beta, "Designing for iPhone Duo", and "Preparing your app for iPhone Duo".

The page also features the following six videos in the form of WWDC sessions:

  • Design for iPhone Duo
  • Prepare your app for iPhone Duo
  • Raise the bar with iPhone Duo
  • Strike a pose with adaptive layouts on iPhone Duo
  • Leverage multiple displays and scenes on iPhone Duo
  • Build a great camera experience for iPhone Duo

You can check out the full set of developer resources Apple has prepared for the iPhone Duo here.
